title.value: GAIT: A Geometric Approach to Information Theory
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned in the paper.
title.quote: GAIT: A Geometric Approach to Information Theory

analysis.description: The paper introduces a geometric approach to information theory, focusing on GAIT (Geometry-Aware Information Theory). It proposes using a similarity-sensitive entropy and a novel divergence that captures the geometric structure within probability distributions. The paper demonstrates the efficacy of these concepts in training generative models, computing image barycenters, approximating empirical measures, and counting modes.

type.justification: The paper mainly develops theoretical concepts around a new notion of entropy and divergence based on geometric similarity.
type.quote: We advocate the use of a notion of entropy that reflects the relative abundances of the symbols in an alphabet, as well as the similarities between them.

name.justification: The paper revolves around theoretical concepts of information theory, focusing on entropy and divergence in geometric spaces.
name.quote: We refer to this collection of concepts as Geometry-Aware Information Theory: GAIT.
